what: Valley National Bancorp is a bank across New Jersey, New York, Florida and Alabama, lending mostly to small and mid-sized businesses and on commercial property.
customers: Small and mid-sized businesses and households in the New York metropolitan area and Florida.
money: commercial and consumer lending funded by deposits
wealth management, insurance and treasury services
moat: Long-standing relationships with small business owners in dense, wealthy markets, which bring deposits that fund the bank cheaply.
risks: Commercial real estate is a very large share of the loan book, concentrated in New York
That concentration has kept the valuation depressed since the 2023 regional banking stress
Deposit costs rise quickly when rates rise
opportunities: 11 times earnings and 8.2 times free cash flow with a 29.5% net margin
The bank has been deliberately reducing its commercial real estate concentration
Analysts see about 23% upside, with 14 covering the stock
watch: Commercial real estate concentration ratio and credit losses.
